name: codex-collab
description: Claude Code と OpenAI Codex CLI の協調タスク実行プラグイン

hooks.command: bash -c 'for d in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "$(ls -td ~/.claude/plugins/cache/codex-collab/codex-collab/*/ 2>/dev/null | head -1)"; do [ -f "$d/hooks/enforce-skill-usage.sh" ] && exec bash "$d/hooks/enforce-skill-usage.sh"; done; exit 0'
